title: Cross-algorithm machine learning predicts DIC progression in sepsis-induced coagulopathy
summary: In 4874 patients with sepsis-induced coagulopathy (1629 local and 3245 from MIMIC-IV), a two-stage framework combined 16 machine learning algorithms and 11 feature-ranking methods to pick consensus features for a minimalist model. The final seven-feature gradient boosting model reached F1 0.71 and AUC 0.75 internally, with external validation on MIMIC-IV. External figures were not visible in the abstract, and discrimination is modest.
ai_technology: Gradient boosting classifier with cross-algorithm consensus feature selection, interpreted with SHAP and a nomogram
organization: Wenzhou Medical University; First Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University

evidence.unknown: External validation figures and prospective utility; full text not reviewed.
